title: Lesson 23 - Programmatic Sharing: Apex Managed Sharing, Apex Sharing Reasons, the Share Object
description: Given a scenario, determine how programmatic sharing supports the record access requirements.

questions.question: A complex, data-derived access rule cannot be expressed with sharing rules. What is the appropriate mechanism?
options: A public group with static rules
Apex Managed Sharing inserting Share rows with a custom RowCause
questions.explanation: Apex Managed Sharing grants record access programmatically where declarative rules cannot. Public OWD over-exposes, and groups/record types cannot express dynamic data-derived access.

questions.question: Which requirement is needed to insert Apex Managed Sharing rows for an object?
options: Modify All on the object for the sharing user
questions.explanation: Modify All on the object is required to create/delete managed share rows; lesser permissions cannot insert shares.

questions.question: What does the RowCause field on a Share record represent?
options: The reason why the share row was created (e.g. your custom managed-sharing reason)
questions.explanation: RowCause records the origin/reason of the share (Manual, Rule, or a custom reason) so you can identify and manage managed-sharing rows. Access level is a separate field.
